02 / THE BIGGER PICTURE

One question. Three perspectives.

From remembering a conversation to understanding a person’s digital life.

Comparison of PersonaMem benchmark releases
What’s being measuredPersonaMem 2025 · COLMPersonaMem-v2 2025PersonaMem-v3 2026
Core challengeRemember evolving preferencesInfer implicit preferencesUnderstand and act across platforms
User foundation20 synthetic personas1,000 synthetic personas200 GIST-Bench user seeds
EvidenceMulti-session conversationsSubtle cues in natural conversationsReal-world-grounded behavior + synthesized digital worlds
Evaluation scope7 query types · 15 topics300+ scenarios · 20,000+ preferences6 connected digital surfaces
New research directionDynamic user profilingReinforcement learning for memoryRecommendation, restraint, and agentic action
